annotations.title: Query the neutral append-only audit log

description: Query SaSame's append-only audit log (meters, receipts, escrow statements, and Agent Work Ledger transitions). Read-only: an empty log returns 0, never fabricated activity. Filter by meter_id, agent_id, kind, or since (ISO timestamp). Use to reconstruct what SaSame recorded; party labels are not legal identities and recorded statements are not independent proof that underlying work or payment occurred.
name: audit_query
